name: Uryu (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Uryu town emblem in yellow: two interlocking lozenge-shaped strokes, like a stylised letter S.
history: Municipal flag of Uryu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 3 November 1954.

features.role: Uryu town emblem — two interlocking lozenge-shaped strokes, like a stylised letter S
